rule: one full evaluation of the speed mix at the start's gains on training episode 1000 + training_order(42)[0] in this process: its CPU seconds (process time) and wall seconds, per episode and in all, with the load average beside; CPU per simulated second = the evaluation's CPU / its simulated seconds (falls end episodes early); projections at that rate over the planned seconds (every episode run to its end, an upper bound once the fit stops falling): the fit's 360 evaluations with 1 and 2 workers (wall = CPU / workers, the cores otherwise idle, and a generation's 12 evaluations split over the workers), speed G5 (4 candidates x 20 evaluations) and the three validation rows (7 conditions x 20 episodes each, the panels' planned seconds)

speed_sources.rule: sha256 over the designlab/stage1 modules the speed fit imports, followed as tune.TUNER_SOURCES_RULE follows the tuner's (from speedfit.py and the package's __init__.py, transitively, module- and function-level imports, read with ast) and hashed as plant.SOURCES_RULE hashes files, the module list recorded beside; every session and worker must run the same (a worker that computes another refuses to start), a resume and the selection refuse a fit made on other sources; the designlab modules outside designlab/stage1 are named by each session's commit and dirty paths (plant.provenance)

stage1_sources.rule: sha256 over designlab/stage1/*.py in path order, each file as its path relative to the package, a NUL byte, its bytes and a NUL byte

start.rule: the fit starts from the body's Stage 1 G5 selection: env.tuned_gains (env.GAINS_RULE) on <Stage 1 run>/<start body>/tune.json, the start body being the body itself or, for a body with no Stage 1 fit (a faster-knee body), the pick it was derived from (--start-from); refused unless that selection passed G5 and holds the fixed gains (tune.FIXED_GAINS); the start is recorded once per body (speedfit/start.json: the record's path and sha256, the candidate and its gains) and every seed and session must start from it
start.source: 60-N-T-10's Stage 1 G5 selection (tune.json: CMA-ES seed 42's G5 selection seed42_gen20)
start.gains_rule: R3's tracker gains are tune.json's body-level G5 selection: of the CMA-ES seeds whose selected candidate passes G5 (seeds[s].pass_ true), the one whose selection ranks first by tune.SELECTION_RULE's key on its validation episodes (fewer falls, then the lower mean S, mean P and mean J; then the lower seed); both PPO seeds train on it.  Without a G5 pass (tune.json missing, G5 failed or not judged) train refuses R3 unless --allow-untuned; the gains are then the same ranking over the judged seeds' selections (flagged 'G5 failed' or 'G5 not judged') or, with none, the tuning start (decision 16, flagged 'untuned')
